summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Eco Wave Power Global AB (publ) as a foreign private issuer furnishing a press release. The press release announces that the company's wave energy technology was featured for the second time in an NVIDIA GTC keynote presentation, highlighting its use of digital twin and simulation technologies. It also provides an update on the advancement of the Taiwan wave energy project, including a land use agreement secured by a local partner. No deal terms, corporate transactions, or special-situation events are disclosed. The filing is a routine current report on business progress and media recognition.
